rateLimit: You're using this command too quickly. Please try again in {minutes} minutes.
timeout: Operation timed out. Please try again.

assignableRole.everyone: The @everyone role can't be handed out.
assignableRole.managed: That role is managed by a bot or integration, so it can't be handed out.
assignableRole.aboveBot: That role is at or above the bot's highest role, so the bot can't grant it. Move the bot's role higher first.
assignableRole.aboveInvoker: That role is at or above your highest role, so you can't set it up to be handed out.
assignableRole.privileged: That role has moderation or admin permissions (such as Administrator, Manage Server, Manage Roles, Manage Messages, Mention @everyone, Ban Members or Mute Members). Only a server admin can set it up to be handed out.
